plan:
- High-temperature induction heating furnace with programmable MCU (ESP32) for precise thermal ramp control.
- Multi-stage precision planetary ball mill for mechanical alloying and particle size reduction of natural precursor minerals.
- High-voltage electrostatic separator to isolate pigments with specific refractory wavelengths.
- Custom 3D-printed enclosure with a modular matryoshka layout to house nested processing chambers.
- Tesseract-frame internal support structure made from carbon-fiber reinforced filaments to withstand mechanical stress.
- Digital flow-control valves for argon-gas shielding to prevent pigment oxidation during the refractory cycle.

subSteps.title: Print Matryoshka chambers and structural mounts
Print high-voltage and magnetic housings
Prepare Tesseract frame and planetary mill base
Install thermal standoffs and reactor chassis liners
Apply epoxy seals to vacuum and cooling interfaces
Configure main power distribution and regulation rails
Wire primary and neural matrix controllers
Connect motor drivers and solenoid actuators
Integrate high-voltage and induction systems
Wire particle monitoring and timing sensors
Establish RF and metric modulation signal paths
Verify I2C/SPI bus integrity and level shifting
Calibrate vacuum and gas flow feedback loops
Test CAN bus communication between controllers
Perform low-power test of H-Bridge and magnetic coils
Verify timing sync and RF phase locking
Mount core reactor and shield assemblies to Tesseract frame
Install Matryoshka nested chambers and crucible rail
Position particle accelerator and ion source
Finalize planetary mill and actuator integration
Secure UI bezel and perform system shielding check

projectDescription: This tesseract-framed synthesizer produces permanent refractory pigments through high-energy nucleosynthesis. It utilizes a Jetson-driven ArcSync reactor, miniature particle accelerator, and induction-heated matryoshka chambers to transmute natural feedstocks within a 432Hz modulated magnetic field, governed by a neural matrix controller for precise isotopic stabilization.

tools: M2, M3, M4, M5, and M6 hex key sets
Vacuum grease and KF25 flange clamps
assumptions: Access to a high-temperature enclosed 3D printing environment
Experience handling high-voltage and vacuum systems
Firmware development environment (PlatformIO or Arduino IDE) configured
Safety protocols for handling ion sources and radioactive feedstock active
